should_trigger: Check whether my current branch is ready for a pull request.
Run local CodeRabbit and tell me what remains before merge.
Inspect the latest PR checks and unresolved review threads.
should_not_trigger: Design the first roadmap for this empty repository.
Turn this architecture plan into an HTML diagram.
expected_behaviors: Inspect the complete diff and untracked files.
Run focused checks and the complete local gate.
Report unavailable CodeRabbit rather than installing it.
Tie CI and review evidence to the latest pull-request commit.
Stop before publishing or merging without separate authorization.
